correctness.rationale: arXiv:2609.37634v1 proves that linked projective spaces are simple normal crossings, gives the exact Mayer--Vietoris simplicial resolution, identifies every nonempty stratum as the scheme-theoretic image of a rational map from projective space, and proves the complexes K_a contractible for |a|<=r. Thus every stratum is smooth projective integral and unirational, so over C its higher O-cohomology vanishes. The hypercohomology spectral sequence therefore reduces to simplicial cohomology of the dual complex. Because zero lies in every independence polytope, K_0 is exactly the dual complex, and its contractibility gives H^0(O_X)=C and H^i(O_X)=0 for i>0.

value.rationale: The initiating paper explicitly asks whether every linked projective space is a flat degeneration of the small diagonal. The accepted theorem shows that every linked projective space shares the full structure-sheaf cohomology of projective space, not merely its Chow class or Euler characteristic, and identifies contractibility of the dual complex as the mechanism. This is a natural global deformation-compatible invariant of the entire class and gives substantive evidence toward the motivating degeneration picture.
